attributes.title: AOSW 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Association of Oncology Social Work will hold its 2027 annual conference as a virtual event on May 26 and 27, 2027. The association announced the dates as a save-the-date; the program, registration and fees had not been posted when we checked in November 2026.

The conference serves social workers in cancer centers, hospitals, hospice and community programs who help patients and families through diagnosis, treatment, survivorship and end of life. A virtual format lets clinicians attend without travel.

AOSW is an ASWB ACE-approved continuing education provider (#1351, approval period through November 11, 2028) and is recognized by the New York State Education Department as a CE provider for licensed social workers. The 2026 in-person conference in Portland offered up to 20.25 CE credits; the number of credits for the 2027 virtual edition has not been announced, so check the conference page before planning your CE hours.
